_README: THE PROBLEM SET. This file is the whole configuration — adding an animation is one
entry here and a rebuild. No code changes.
Read by BOTH build_animations.py and verify_animations.py, on purpose. The verifier
must not take the problem statement from the artifact it is checking, or it would only
prove index.html is self-consistent — a corrupted 247 would verify happily against its
own corrupted answer. Checking against this file instead means a drifted build fails.
kind : 'mult' (x times y) or 'div' (x divided by y)
x, y : the worked example. Everything else — title, skill line, rules, the traps, the
area model, the you-try problems — is DERIVED from the shape of these two.
Constraint that is not obvious: y must never be 1 for a division. Asif, 2026-08-01:
'I really don't like it when we divide by 1 - it's a waste of time for the kid.'
See DRILLS.md, which measured 7 of 10 math-drills variants leaking divide-by-1.
